chinese_name: 清源：主动认知环境免疫、操纵断链与证据回流系统
mission: interrupt exploitative monetization and vulnerable targeting
return provenance, uncertainty, counterevidence, and appeal
support real-life decision protection without forced belief change
apply user-controlled local feed shielding without deleting source records
not_equivalent_to: suppressing criticism, dissent, satire, minority views, or bad news
classifying people as good, bad, low-cognition, or mentally ill
automatic fact, intent, legality, or capacity adjudication
